title: Client Changes Don't Reach the Server
summary: When a LocalScript modifies instances or leaderstats, only THAT client sees it. Other players — and the server — keep the old state. Gameplay mutations must flow through the server.

explanation.whatItIs: Your client lives in a private mirror world. Edits there are real — to you alone.
explanation.whyItExists: If client edits replicated, every exploiter would own the game. Authority flows one way: server → clients.
symptoms: 'It works on my screen' but teammates see nothing
leaderstats updated by LocalScript — scoreboard unchanged for others
Parts created client-side vanish/revert for everyone else
explanation.fix: Send the INTENT via RemoteEvent; let a server Script validate and make the change. Client-side visuals (your camera, your UI) are the exception, not gameplay.
tips: Test with TWO clients (Studio → Test → Clients: 2) to catch this early
Prediction: apply locally for feel, reconcile with server truth
commonMistakes: Currency/shop changes in LocalScripts — exploitable AND invisible to others
Assuming 'server showed it to me' means 'server will show my edits to others'

examples.title: Intent, not edit
examples.code:
-- ❌ LocalScript (only you see it):
-- player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += 100

-- ✅ LocalScript sends intent:
local remote = game.ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.AddCoins
remote:FireServer(100)

-- ✅ Server Script validates + applies for everyone:
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, amount)
    if typeof(amount) ~= "number" or amount <= 0 then return end
    -- …validate the source (earned it?) then:
    player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += math.floor(amount)
end)
